facts.text: Scout is a RAG-first recruiter assistant. For substantive questions, ProjectHub rewrites the conversation-aware query, runs local BM25/RRF retrieval over verified knowledge, selects a small set of relevant evidence, sends that grounded evidence to the configured generative model, and then runs factual validation before returning the answer. Structured tools may enrich the evidence but do not replace RAG as the primary answer context.

ProjectHub does not run the primary language model locally. Query/session handling, BM25/RRF retrieval, evidence selection, relationship checks, factual validation, telemetry, and persistence run in ProjectHub's own backend process. Normal generative inference on the current dev and production configuration is hosted by Cloudflare Workers AI using @cf/meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct. Ollama is only an optional fallback when explicitly configured.

Scout can operate at zero billed inference cost while usage stays inside Cloudflare Workers AI's included free allocation and the rest of ProjectHub stays inside its free-tier infrastructure allowances. The model still consumes measurable tokens and neurons; free does not mean the inference has no resource cost. ProjectHub tracks usage so the free-tier budget can be observed rather than guessed.

Cloudflare Workers AI includes 10,000 neurons per day on the free allocation, resetting at 00:00 UTC. This allocation is an account-level model-compute budget, not a separate 10,000-neuron allowance for each visitor. If the free allocation is exhausted, Cloudflare can reject inference with a rate/allocation error; ProjectHub does not intentionally switch to a paid-only model as an automatic fallback.

For @cf/meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct, ProjectHub uses Cloudflare's published neuron rates of 4,625 neurons per million input tokens and 30,475 neurons per million output tokens to estimate usage when the provider does not return an actual neuron count. Cloudflare's public Workers AI paid-usage reference is $0.011 per 1,000 neurons beyond the included allocation on Workers Paid. A metered-value estimate is not the same as an actual billed charge.

ProjectHub's application-level request protection is separate from Cloudflare's daily AI allocation. The server currently defaults to 20 chat requests per minute per IP address unless configuration overrides it. This is a rolling request-rate control, not a video-game cooldown. There is no documented per-user daily chat cap in Scout's current runtime facts; the important daily model budget is the shared Workers AI neuron allocation.

Scout telemetry can report the prose source, provider, model, provider-call count, input and output tokens, actual or estimated neurons, model latency, repair attempts, retrieval candidate count, selected evidence count, browser-session totals, and backend daily usage when available. MODEL_GENERATION means a model authored the visible answer from retrieved evidence; DIRECT_KB means verified knowledge supplied the answer without a generative model call; TECHNICAL_ERROR means generation or factual validation failed closed.

The public ProjectHub widget is served from GitHub Pages. ProjectHub's chat backend runs separately and calls Cloudflare Workers AI for normal generative inference. The architecture is designed to keep model context small by retrieving only relevant evidence instead of sending the entire knowledge base for every question.
